mapper.select: SELECT d.grade, d.status, d.week_start AS generation_week, d.planned_week, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme p WHERE p.grade = COALESCE(t.grade,d.grade) AND p.week_start = COALESCE(t.week_start,d.planned_week) AND p.status='PUBLISHED') AS week_locked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme p WHERE p.grade = COALESCE(t.grade,d.grade) AND p.week_start = COALESCE(t.week_start,d.planned_week,d.week_start) AND p.status='PUBLISHED') AS adoption_week_locked, (d.input -> 'regenerate' ->> 'baseDraftId' IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM theme_draft child WHERE child.family_root_id=d.id AND child.status='ADOPTED')) AS root FROM theme_draft d LEFT JOIN weekly_theme t ON t.id=d.theme_id WHERE d.id=#{id}

SELECT id AS draft_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(output -> 'theme' ->> 'title',''),input ->> 'topic','테마 초안') AS title, week_start AS generation_week, planned_week FROM theme_draft d WHERE grade=#{grade} AND status='READY' AND input -> 'regenerate' ->> 'baseDraftId' IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme_draft child WHERE child.family_root_id=d.id AND child.status='ADOPTED') ORDER BY planned_week NULLS LAST, created_at DESC, id
SELECT week_start FROM theme_draft WHERE theme_id=#{themeId}

SELECT t.id AS theme_id, v.title, t.status, v.version FROM weekly_theme t JOIN weekly_theme_version v ON v.id = CASE WHEN t.status='PUBLISHED' THEN t.published_version_id ELSE t.current_version_id END WHERE t.grade=#{grade} AND t.week_start=#{week} ORDER BY (t.status='PUBLISHED') DESC, t.created_at,t.id
SELECT id FROM theme_draft WHERE grade=#{grade} AND planned_week=#{week}
mapper.update: UPDATE theme_draft SET planned_week=#{week,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='READY'
UPDATE theme_draft SET planned_week=NULL WHERE grade=#{grade} AND planned_week=#{week}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id FROM mission m JOIN weekly_theme_day d ON d.mission_id=m.id WHERE d.theme_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY m.id FOR UPDATE OF m
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_theme_day d SET mission_version_id=COALESCE(d.mission_version_id,m.published_version_id), rubric_version_id=COALESCE(d.rubric_version_id,m.published_rubric_version_id) FROM mission m WHERE d.theme_version_id=#{versionId} AND m.id=d.mission_id AND m.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.published_version_id IS NOT NULL AND m.published_rubric_version_id IS NOT NULL
